say:0:1321401001:0.text: There are many elderly people in Cedartown. Should we ask them about the Kaminsky family?
say:0:1321401001:0.source_cn: 雪松镇上有不少老人呢，要不要向他们打听一下卡明斯基家族？

say:1:1321401002:0.text: Valka said they were an important family around here in the past.
say:1:1321401002:0.source_cn: 瓦丽卡之前说过，卡明斯基当年也是大家族呢。

say:2:1321402001:1.text: Hello, ma'am. You must be a local around here. Have you ever heard of the Kaminsky family?
say:2:1321402001:1.source_cn: 奶奶，你一定是本地人吧！你有没有听说过卡明斯基家族？

say:3:1321402002:1.source_cn: 卡明斯基……这名字好熟悉……

say:4:1321402003:1.text: Oh, I remember. When I was a girl, there were two families in town with the last name Kaminsky.
say:4:1321402003:1.source_cn: ……哦，我记起来了。我小的时候，镇上还有两家姓卡明斯基的人。

say:5:1321402004:1.text: But they moved away a long time ago. It was probably before I was ten years old...
say:5:1321402004:1.source_cn: 不过，他们很早就搬走了，应该都是我十岁之前的事了……

choice_prompt:6:1321402004.text: But they moved away a long time ago. It was probably before I was ten years old...
choice_prompt:6:1321402004.source_cn: 不过，他们很早就搬走了，应该都是我十岁之前的事了……

say:7:1321402005:1.source_cn: 是啊，要不怎么叫举家搬迁哟……

say:8:1321402006:1.text: If you want to find out more about the Kaminsky family, you could go ask around <style="highlight">near the restaurant</style> in town. I do recall there was a distant relative in the area.
say:8:1321402006:1.source_cn: 你们是想打听卡明斯基的事？那不如去镇上的<style=...

say:9:1321402007:1.text: Let me think... Ah, the <style="highlight">Kalev</style> family. There should still be a few youngsters from that family in town.

say:0:1321403001:0.text: The house closest to the restaurant is this one. Could that child be from the Kalev family?
say:0:1321403001:0.source_cn: 离餐厅最近的房子就是这一栋了，那个小孩会是卡列夫一家的人吗？

say:2:1321404001:1.text: Hello, young man. Are you from the Kalev family?
say:2:1321404001:1.source_cn: 小朋友，你是卡洛夫家的人吗？

say:3:1321404002:1.text:
How did you know?
You don't seem like you're from Cedartown.
say:3:1321404002:1.source_cn: 你们会怎么知道？\n……你们也不像是雪松镇的人啊。
say:3:1321404002:1.male:
How did you know?
You don't seem like you're from Cedartown.
say:3:1321404002:1.female:
How did you know?
You don't seem like you're from Cedartown.

say:6:1321404003:1.text: Have you ever heard of the Kaminsky family?
say:6:1321404003:1.source_cn: 你听说过卡明斯基家族吗？

say:7:1321404004:1.text: Hmm... I think my older brother mentioned them once. They're supposed to be our distant relatives.
say:7:1321404004:1.source_cn: 唔，我听我哥哥提起过，好像是关系很远的亲戚……

say:8:1321404005:1.text: Are you from the Kaminsky family?
say:8:1321404005:1.source_cn: 难道你们是那个家族的人？

choice_prompt:9:1321404005.text: Are you from the Kaminsky family?
choice_prompt:9:1321404005.source_cn: 难道你们是那个家族的人？

say:10:1321404006:1.text: Okay... Well, I only know that their family is somehow connected to our family. That's about it.
say:10:1321404006:1.source_cn: 好吧！不过，我只知道卡明斯基好像是我们家的亲戚，其余就...

say:11:1321404007:1.text: You could ask my brother. He went out this morning to go see the hero's <style="highlight">ice sculpture</style>.
say:11:1321404007:1.source_cn: 要不然，你们还是去问我哥哥吧！他早上出门去看<styl...

say:12:1321404008:1.text: Oh, so he must admire Val... I mean, he must admire the general, then.
say:12:1321404008:1.source_cn: 咦？他很崇拜瓦——呃，很崇拜那位女将军吗？

say:13:1321404009:1.text: I guess so. Every time he's in a bad mood, he goes to see her.
say:13:1321404009:1.source_cn: 嗯……我猜是吧？反正他心情不好的时候就会去看英雄冰雕。

say:14:1321404010:1.text: If you're going to find him, can you take me with you? He hasn't come home for a bit, and I want to talk to him.
say:14:1321404010:1.source_cn: 你们要去找他的话，可以带上我吗？他一直没回家，我想去找他！

say:15:1321404011:1.text: Yeah, sure. We can take you to him.
say:15:1321404011:1.source_cn: 那好吧，你就跟我们一起去吧！

choice:9:0:1.source_cn: 我们在找卡明斯基的后裔

say:3:1321406001:1.text: Hey, why is there a person lying in front of the ice sculpture?
say:3:1321406001:1.source_cn: 奇怪，冰雕前面怎么躺着个人，还说着乱七八糟的话……

say:5:1321406003:1.source_cn: 哎？倒在地上的这个人就是你哥哥？！

say:6:1321406004:1.text: Yeah, I think he went drinking again. Otherwise, he wouldn't have been away so long.
say:6:1321406004:1.source_cn: 是啊。我就猜到他去喝酒了，不然才不会这么久都不回家！

say:7:1321406005:1.text: Wake up, Stephan! It's time to go home!
say:7:1321406005:1.source_cn: 哥哥，快醒醒，该回家了！有人找你！

say:8:1321406006:1.text: Wait a moment. His complexion seems off... He's been lying in the snow for too long. He may have hypothermia.
say:8:1321406006:1.source_cn: 等一下，他的脸色好像不太对……像是在雪地里躺了太久，有...

say:9:1321406007:1.text: We need to have a way to quickly warm him up.
say:9:1321406007:1.source_cn: 我们得赶紧想办法，让他暖和起来才行！

say:10:1321406008:1.text: Let's make a fire, then! Or Chippy can take off his clothes for him to wear!
say:10:1321406008:1.source_cn: 那……那就生火吧！或者满满把衣服脱下来给他穿！

choice_prompt:11:1321406008.text: Let's make a fire, then! Or Chippy can take off his clothes for him to wear!
choice_prompt:11:1321406008.source_cn: 那……那就生火吧！或者满满把衣服脱下来给他穿！

say:12:1321406009:1.text: There's an <style="highlight">ice mine</style> nearby. The <style="highlight">dwarves</style> should have something warm to drink.

say:13:1321406012:1.text: I'll go ask them for help!
say:13:1321406012:1.source_cn: 我、我这就去找他们帮忙！

choice:11:0:1.source_cn: 附近有没有能帮忙的人？

say:15:1321406010:1.text: But where can we find something like that?
say:15:1321406010:1.source_cn: 可是……现在该上哪找热饮啊？！

say:16:1321406011:1.text: There's an <style="highlight">ice mine</style> nearby. The <style="highlight">dwarves</style> should have something warm to drink.

say:3:1321407001:1.text: Excuse me, do you have anything hot to drink? Something that can warm up the body? It would be best if it could also help with hangovers.
say:3:1321407001:1.source_cn: 不好意思，请问你们这里有没有能让身体暖和起来的热饮？最...

say:4:1321407002:1.text: Oh, did someone get drunk and sleep in the snow again?
say:4:1321407002:1.source_cn: 哟，又有人喝醉了睡在雪地里了？

say:6:1321407004:1.text: Ha! I have the overnight shift. I'm used to seeing people doing dumb things like this.
say:6:1321407004:1.source_cn: 哈哈，通宵赶工之后老有人干这种蠢事，我都习惯了。

say:7:1321407005:1.text: There's some <style="highlight">hot hangover brew</style> in my pack. It's hot and spicy and can even up the dead. You can find it in there.

say:8:1321407006:1.text: By the way, can you help organize my pack after you're done? I still have a lot of work to do.
say:8:1321407006:1.source_cn: 拿完之后，记得帮我把包整理好，我还得干活儿呢。

say:0:1321408001:0.text: This is the hot drink we need! Let's hurry back to my brother!
say:0:1321408001:0.source_cn: 找到热饮了！我们赶快回去拿给哥哥吧！

say:3:1321410001:1.text: Stephan! You went drinking again, and we found you lying in the snow!
say:3:1321410001:1.source_cn: 哥哥！你又喝酒，还躺在雪地里！

say:4:1321410002:1.text: Something might've happened if no one found you... Please, I don't want to be alone...
say:4:1321410002:1.source_cn: 如果不是有人来找你，出事了该怎么办？你不能丢下我一个人……

say:6:1321410004:1.text: Thank you for staying with Peter.
say:6:1321410004:1.source_cn: 也得谢谢你们，陪彼得来找我。
say:6:1321410004:1.male: Thank you for staying with Peter.
say:6:1321410004:1.female: Thank you for staying with Peter.

choice_prompt:7:1321410004.text: Thank you for staying with Peter.
choice_prompt:7:1321410004.source_cn: 也得谢谢你们，陪彼得来找我。
choice_prompt:7:1321410004.male: Thank you for staying with Peter.
choice_prompt:7:1321410004.female: Thank you for staying with Peter.

say:8:1321410005:1.text: Why were you lying in the snow? You can't just gloss over that.
say:8:1321410005:1.source_cn: 对了，你为什么要躺在雪地里？你还没回答我呢！

say:9:1321410007:1.text: Sorry... I wasn't in a great mood.
say:9:1321410007:1.source_cn: 抱歉……我只是心情不太好。

say:10:1321410008:1.text: I planned to come here to lay flowers for the hero, but when I left Cedartown, I bought a bottle. I thought it'd warm me up on the way, but then I just passed out.
say:10:1321410008:1.source_cn: 原本我是打算过来为英雄献花的。但离开雪松镇时，我买了一...

say:11:1321410009:1.text: Oh, I didn't even have time to pick flowers...
say:11:1321410009:1.source_cn: 说起来，我连花都没来得及采，真是……

say:12:1321410010:1.text: Don't worry about it. I'll go pick some <style="highlight">sapphirine blossoms</style>.
say:12:1321410010:1.source_cn: 不用担心这个，我可以帮你去<style=highlig...

say:13:1321410011:1.text: No, not by yourself. Remember what our parents told you before. Never leave town alone.
say:13:1321410011:1.source_cn: 不行，你不能一个人去。爸妈以前交代过什么，你都忘了吗？...

say:14:1321410012:1.text: But you left me alone at home!
say:14:1321410012:1.source_cn: 那你还不是把我一个人丢在家里！哼！

say:15:1321410013:1.text: It's okay. We can go together.
say:15:1321410013:1.source_cn: 没关系，我们可以陪你一起去。

say:16:1321410014:1.text: Ah, that's great. Please stay close to Peter and make sure nothing happens to him.
say:16:1321410014:1.source_cn: 啊，那太好了。麻烦你们陪着彼得，不要让他出事。

say:18:1321410006:1.text: Yeah, you told me that you were only coming to see the ice sculpture.
say:18:1321410006:1.source_cn: 啊！对啊，你明明和我说是来看英雄冰雕的！

choice:7:1:2.text: Why were you lying in the snow?
choice:7:1:2.source_cn: 你为什么要躺在雪地里？
choice:7:1:2.male: Why were you lying in the snow?
choice:7:1:2.female: Why were you lying in the snow?

say:0:1321411001:0.text: Where's my brother? Where did he run off to this time?
say:0:1321411001:0.source_cn: 奇怪，我哥哥怎么不见了？他又去哪了？

say:1:1321411002:0.text: There should be footprints in the snow. Let's check.
say:1:1321411002:0.source_cn: 雪地上应该会留下脚印，在附近找找看吧。

say:0:1321412001:0.text: There are footprints here! It's going toward the mine!
say:0:1321412001:0.source_cn: 果然，这里有脚印！像是朝着矿洞过去了！

say:0:1321413001:0.text: There are footprints here, also. My brother went inside the mine!
say:0:1321413001:0.source_cn: 这里也有脚印，我哥哥进入了矿洞！

say:1:1321413002:0.text: But what's he doing here at the mine?
say:1:1321413002:0.source_cn: 不过……他进矿洞里做什么？

say:0:1321414001:0.text: The footprints stop here, but there's no one around...
say:0:1321414001:0.source_cn: 脚印到这里就没了，但还是不见人影……

say:1:1321414002:0.text: Let's go ask that dwarf who gave us the hangover brew.
say:1:1321414002:0.source_cn: 我们去找刚才那位借给我们解酒饮料的矮人问问吧。

say:3:1321415001:1.text: Why are you here again? Don't tell me want more hangover brew.
say:3:1321415001:1.source_cn: 你们怎么又来了？解酒的东西可不能多喝！

say:4:1321415002:1.text: No, no, no! We're here to find someone. Did a young man pass by here earlier?
say:4:1321415002:1.source_cn: 不不不，我们是来找人的！刚才有没有一个年轻男人经过这里？

say:5:1321415003:1.text: Yes, he looks a little like the kid next to us. He may also smell of booze.
say:5:1321415003:1.source_cn: 外貌特点的话……嗯，他长得和我们身边这个小朋友有点像，...

say:6:1321415004:1.text: Yeah, someone like that did pass by.
say:6:1321415004:1.source_cn: 噢，刚才的确有那么个年轻人经过。

say:7:1321415005:1.text: He was mumbling about something... I think he was saying that he wasn't a coward or some such. Anyway, he didn't seem completely there if you know what I'm saying.
say:7:1321415005:1.source_cn: 他过去的时候，还嘟嘟囔囔地说着什么，好像是在说自己不是...

say:10:1321415006:1.text: Do you know where he went?
say:10:1321415006:1.source_cn: 那、那您知道他去哪了吗？

say:11:1321415007:1.text: Hey, kid, the mine is only this big. Other than that exit there, where else can he go?
say:11:1321415007:1.source_cn: 嘿，小伙子，矿洞就这么大，除了另一个出口，他还能去哪？

say:12:1321415008:1.text: That exit?! That leads to the <style="highlight">ancient battlefield</style>. There are still undead there!

say:16:1321415010:1.text: Magister, we have to hurry! Stephan may encounter the undead!
say:16:1321415010:1.source_cn: 主人，我们得赶快追上他！万一碰到活死人就不好了！
say:16:1321415010:1.male: Magister, we have to hurry! Stephan may encounter the undead!
say:16:1321415010:1.female: Magister, we have to hurry! Stephan may encounter the undead!

say:20:1321415012:1.text: The ancient battlefield is really dangerous. Why don't you go back to town? Your brother will be very worried if he sees you there.
say:20:1321415012:1.source_cn: 古战场很危险，你还是不要去了吧？要不然你哥哥看到你也会...

say:21:1321415013:1.text: No, I have to find my brother! You can't stop me! I'll go alone if I have to!
say:21:1321415013:1.source_cn: 不行，我必须要去找哥哥！你们劝我也没用！

say:22:1321415014:1.text: Alright... Then you have to follow behind us and not wander off!
say:22:1321415014:1.source_cn: 唉，好吧……那你得一直跟着我们，不许乱跑！

say:0:1321416001:0.text: We're going to the ancient battlefield. Won't your parents be worried, Peter?
say:0:1321416001:0.source_cn: 彼得，你跟着我们去古战场，你父母不会担心吗？

say:1:1321416002:0.text: My parents passed away a long time ago. There's only me and my brother.
say:1:1321416002:0.source_cn: 没关系……爸妈早就去世了，家里只有我和哥哥。

say:2:1321416003:0.text: Otherwise, we wouldn't have moved to the town...
say:2:1321416003:0.source_cn: 不然的话，我们也不会从远郊搬到镇上来了……

say:0:1321417001:0.text: Don't worry, Peter. If we follow the footprints, we'll find your brother.
say:0:1321417001:0.source_cn: 彼得，别担心，跟着脚印一直走就能找到你哥哥了。

say:1:1321417002:0.text: My brother will be fine. He used to be a patrol captain a long time ago.
say:1:1321417002:0.source_cn: 我知道，哥哥他一定会没事的！他以前可是公国卫队的巡逻队长呢！

say:2:1321417003:0.text: If it weren't for that accident, he wouldn't have been discharged, and no one would call him a coward.
say:2:1321417003:0.source_cn: 如果不是那次意外……他才不会被开除呢，更不会被大家说是懦夫！

say:3:1321417004:0.text: I believe in him! Whatever my brother does, there must be a reason!
say:3:1321417004:0.source_cn: 反正我相信他！无论我哥哥做什么，都肯定是有原因的！

say:0:1321419001:0.text: There's my brother! He seems to be injured!
say:0:1321419001:0.source_cn: 我哥哥在那！他……他好像受伤了！

say:1:1321419002:0.text: We need to drive off the undead!
say:1:1321419002:0.source_cn: 那得赶快赶走活死人才行！

say:4:1321420002:1.text: It's alright. It's not a serious wound. You don't need to worry about me.
say:4:1321420002:1.source_cn: 行了，又不是什么很严重的伤。小小年纪，不要总是替我操心。

say:5:1321420003:1.text: You all didn't need to help me, but thanks anyway.
say:5:1321420003:1.source_cn: 其实你们不用帮我的……不过，还是谢谢你们。
say:5:1321420003:1.male: You all didn't need to help me, but thanks anyway.
say:5:1321420003:1.female: You all didn't need to help me, but thanks anyway.

choice_prompt:6:1321420003.text: You all didn't need to help me, but thanks anyway.
choice_prompt:6:1321420003.source_cn: 其实你们不用帮我的……不过，还是谢谢你们。
choice_prompt:6:1321420003.male: You all didn't need to help me, but thanks anyway.
choice_prompt:6:1321420003.female: You all didn't need to help me, but thanks anyway.

say:7:1321420004:1.text: That's right. We went to help you pick flowers, and then you disappeared on us!
say:7:1321420004:1.source_cn: 就是说啊。我们去帮你采花，你却到处乱跑！

say:10:1321420005:1.text: Rather than thanking us, tell us why you came here to fight the undead alone.
say:10:1321420005:1.source_cn: 比起感谢，我们还是更想知道你为什么要独自跑到古战场来，...

say:11:1321420008:1.text: Not long ago, I was a member of the ducal guard. Thanks to the guard captain, I even became the leader of a small patrol team.
say:11:1321420008:1.source_cn: 不久之前，我还是公国卫队的卫兵。鉴于卫队长的赏识，我甚...

say:12:1321420009:1.text: A while ago, when I was on patrol, I encountered an undead squatting on a tombstone. He was hunched over, wearing a helmet with his face covered. There was a sword stuck through his throat... My team members were terrified.
say:12:1321420009:1.source_cn: 前阵子，我带人巡逻的时候遇到了一个蹲在墓碑上的活死人。...

say:13:1321420010:1.text: But he didn't hurt anyone like the other undead. Instead, he helped some lost children find their way home. So, we let him go.
say:13:1321420010:1.source_cn: 出人意料的是，他没有像其他活死人那样伤害人类，反而在为...

say:16:1321420011:1.text: You must be talking about Igor! We know him!
say:16:1321420011:1.source_cn: 咦？你说的这个人好像是伊戈尔！我们认识他！

say:19:1321420012:1.text: Yes, Igor is not a bad person. He just likes to play with children. Thank you for not hurting him.
say:19:1321420012:1.source_cn: 是啊。伊戈尔不是坏人，他只是比较喜欢和小孩子玩。谢谢你...

say:20:1321420013:1.text: Good, I'm glad my intuition wasn't wrong,
say:20:1321420013:1.source_cn: 哈……我就知道我的判断不会出错。

say:21:1321420014:1.text: However, my team members were unhappy with the decision.
say:21:1321420014:1.source_cn: 不过……哈，我的队员们对我放走活死人这件事很不满。

say:22:1321420015:1.text: They think I was too scared to fight, that I let the undead go because I was a coward...
say:22:1321420015:1.source_cn: 他们认为我不敢和活死人战斗，认为我是因为懦弱才放走了活...

say:23:1321420016:1.text: Later, I was punished and expelled from the guard.
say:23:1321420016:1.source_cn: ……再后来，我就收到了处分，被开除出卫队。

say:24:1321420017:1.text: So, you want to fight the undead here to prove that you're not a coward.
say:24:1321420017:1.source_cn: 所以，你想要击败这些活死人，以此来证明自己不是懦夫？

say:25:1321420018:1.text:
That's right...
I'm not doing this only for myself but for Peter as well.
say:25:1321420018:1.source_cn: ……没错。\n既是为了我自己，也是为了彼得。

choice_prompt:26:1321420018.text:
That's right...
I'm not doing this only for myself but for Peter as well.
choice_prompt:26:1321420018.source_cn: ……没错。\n既是为了我自己，也是为了彼得。

say:27:1321420019:1.text: After I was expelled from the guard, everyone thought I was a coward. A lot of people made fun of Peter as well. Other children in town refused to play with him.
say:27:1321420019:1.source_cn: 我被开除之后，有很多人觉得我是懦夫，所以连带着彼得……...

say:28:1321420020:1.text: All of this is my fault...

say:30:1321420022:1.text: You don't understand, Peter. When our parents were dying, they told me over and over to take care of you.
say:30:1321420022:1.source_cn: 好了，彼得，你还不明白。爸妈临终时，嘱咐过无数遍，让我...

say:32:1321420024:1.text: Oh, there's a wound on your back, and it looks serious! It must be treated right away!
say:32:1321420024:1.source_cn: 哎呀，你背上怎么还有一道伤！而且看起来好严重……必须马...

say:33:1321420025:1.text: Where's your healing potion? Don't you always carry it with you?
say:33:1321420025:1.source_cn: 哥哥，你的治疗药剂呢？你平时不是都会随身带着吗？赶快拿...

say:34:1321420026:1.text: They're useless for wounds like this...
say:34:1321420026:1.source_cn: 没什么用的，那些药恐怕止不住这么严重的伤……

say:35:1321420027:1.text: Hey, <style="stress"><player_name></style> is the most powerful mage around. He can use magic to turn common healing potions into <style="highlight">greater healing potions</style>. That will definitely help with your injuries.
say:35:1321420027:1.male: Hey, <style="stress"><player_name></style> is the most powerful mage around. He can use magic to turn common healing potions into <style="highlight">greater healing potions</style>. That will definitely help with your injuries.
say:35:1321420027:1.female: Hey, <style="stress"><player_name></style> is the most powerful mage around. She can use magic to turn common healing potions into <style="highlight">greater healing potions</style>. That will definitely help with your injuries.

say:36:1321420028:1.text: Let's not delay. Let's make a greater healing potion!
say:36:1321420028:1.source_cn: 没时间拖延了……赶快炼制强力药剂吧！
say:36:1321420028:1.male: Let's not delay. Let's make a greater healing potion!
say:36:1321420028:1.female: Let's not delay. Let's make a greater healing potion!

document:37:133:0.text: Starting with some <style="highlight">healing potion</style>, add <style="highlight">firethorn fruit</style> and a small amount of <style="highlight">clotting oil</style>. Then, infuse it with magic to greatly enhance its healing properties.
document:37:133:0.source_cn: 往市面上最常见的<style="highlight">治疗药剂</style>中加入<style="highlight">血剑果</style>和少量<style="highlight">凝血油</style>，之后注入魔力，就可以大幅提升药剂的治疗效果。
document:37:133:0.male: Starting with some <style="highlight">healing potion</style>, add <style="highlight">firethorn fruit</style> and a small amount of <style="highlight">clotting oil</style>. Then, infuse it with magic to greatly enhance its healing properties.
document:37:133:0.female: Starting with some <style="highlight">healing potion</style>, add <style="highlight">firethorn fruit</style> and a small amount of <style="highlight">clotting oil</style>. Then, infuse it with magic to greatly enhance its healing properties.

say:42:1321420029:0.text: We did it! Let's <style="highlight">treat your wounds</style> with this.
say:42:1321420029:0.source_cn: 万幸，强力药剂的炼制很顺利呢！快点用它来<style=...

choice:26:0:1.text: What does this have to do with Peter?
choice:26:0:1.male: What does this have to do with Peter?
choice:26:0:1.female: What does this have to do with Peter?

choice:6:0:1.text: You want to thank us? Stop running around.
choice:6:0:1.source_cn: 你别再乱跑就是最好的感谢了
choice:6:0:1.male: You want to thank us? Stop running around.
choice:6:0:1.female: You want to thank us? Stop running around.

say:45:1321420006:1.text: I know... but I have to do this.
say:45:1321420006:1.source_cn: 我知道，但是……唉，我不得不这样做。

choice:6:1:2.text: Peter was very worried about you.
choice:6:1:2.male: Peter was very worried about you.
choice:6:1:2.female: Peter was very worried about you.

choice:6:2:3.text: Why shouldn't I have helped you?
choice:6:2:3.male: Why shouldn't I have helped you?
choice:6:2:3.female: Why shouldn't I have helped you?

say:3:1321421001:1.source_cn: 怎么样，你现在感觉还好吗？

say:4:1321421002:1.text: I feel much better... The bleeding stopped, and it doesn't hurt as much as before.
say:4:1321421002:1.source_cn: 确实好多了……伤口没有之前那么疼，出血好像也止住了。

say:5:1321421003:1.source_cn: 是啊，哥哥你的脸色都好了不少呢！

say:6:1321421004:1.text: Thank you for everything you've done today. Not only did you keep Peter safe, but you've helped me so much as well.
say:6:1321421004:1.source_cn: 今天的事都要感谢你们。不但一直陪着彼得，还帮了我这么多。
say:6:1321421004:1.male: Thank you for everything you've done today. Not only did you keep Peter safe, but you've helped me so much as well.
say:6:1321421004:1.female: Thank you for everything you've done today. Not only did you keep Peter safe, but you've helped me so much as well.

say:9:1321421005:1.text: You're welcome! We actually have something we need to ask you.
say:9:1321421005:1.source_cn: 不用客气！其实我们来找你，也是有事想要问你。

say:10:1321421006:1.text: Do you know the Kaminsky family? According to someone in town, you two are the only people related to them in the Duchy of Whiteridge.
say:10:1321421006:1.source_cn: 你知道卡明斯基家族吗？听镇上的老人说，他们在白山公国的...

say:11:1321421007:1.text: Yes, but I have a question. Why are you interested in the Kaminsky family?
say:11:1321421007:1.source_cn: 我的确知道一些事。但我得冒昧问一句，你们为什么要打听卡...

choice_prompt:12:1321421007.text: Yes, but I have a question. Why are you interested in the Kaminsky family?
choice_prompt:12:1321421007.source_cn: 我的确知道一些事。但我得冒昧问一句，你们为什么要打听卡明斯基的事？

say:13:1321421008:1.text: What soldier? There hasn't been a soldier of the Kaminsky family for a long time...
say:13:1321421008:1.source_cn: 战士？不对啊，卡明斯基家族很久都没有出过战士了……

say:14:1321421009:1.text: You'll understand when you read the inscription on this talisman.
say:14:1321421009:1.source_cn: 你看了这个护身符就都明白了！

say:19:1321421013:1.text: We found this on an undead warrior. You probably don't know, but the undead wandering the ancient battlefield are actually the soldiers who fought the Divine War.
say:19:1321421013:1.source_cn: 这是我们在一个活死人身上找到的东西。你应该还不知道……...

say:20:1321421014:1.text: The warrior must've been very brave during his life because he stayed here even after his death to drive off the Hypogeans and their ilk.
say:20:1321421014:1.source_cn: 我想，那位战士生前一定非常英勇，所以直到死后依然坚守在...

say:21:1321421015:1.text: So, we wanted to return this talisman to his descendants.
say:21:1321421015:1.source_cn: 所以我们才想把这枚护身符还给他的后裔。

say:23:1321421017:1.text: Why do you look so excited, Stephan? The Kaminsky family has nothing to do with us.
say:23:1321421017:1.source_cn: 哥哥你这么激动干嘛？卡明斯基的事和我们又没什么关系。

say:24:1321421018:1.text: Nothing to do with us? Peter, we are the Kaminsky family! That's our real last name!
say:24:1321421018:1.source_cn: 没关系？！怎么可能没关系！卡明斯基……彼得，我们就是卡...

say:28:1321421020:1.text: Huh? Isn't your last name Kalev?
say:28:1321421020:1.source_cn: 什么？！你们不是姓卡列夫吗？！

say:29:1321421021:1.text: Kalev is the surname our family took on later. Look here! This is the family ring that my parents gave me when they were on their deathbed. It has the Kaminsky family coat of arms on it!
say:29:1321421021:1.source_cn: 卡列夫只是一个后改的姓！你们看，这是我父母临终时交给我...

say:32:1321421022:1.text: It looks just like the emblem on the back of the talisman... This must be true.
say:32:1321421022:1.source_cn: 和护身符背面的纹章一样……居然是真的。

say:33:1321421023:1.text: Yes, who would've thought I'd ever hear someone singing the praises of the Kaminsky family...?
say:33:1321421023:1.source_cn: 是啊……我也从来没想过，居然有机会从别人口中听到夸耀卡...

say:35:1321421024:1.text: What do you mean? Weren't the ancestors of everyone in Cedartown all warriors who fought against the Hypogeans?
say:35:1321421024:1.source_cn: 为什么这么说？现在雪松镇镇民们的先祖，不都是对抗恶魔的...

say:36:1321421025:1.text: Yes, mostly... But our ancestor kind of caused trouble in town.
say:36:1321421025:1.source_cn: 是的，但我们那位先祖……在镇上惹出过乱子。

say:37:1321421026:1.text: Like you said, our ancestor became one of the undead... Once, he tried to return to town and reunite with his family.
say:37:1321421026:1.source_cn: 就像你们说的那样，我们的先祖的确变成了活死人。然后……...

say:39:1321421027:1.text: Oh, that probably scared a lot of people...
say:39:1321421027:1.source_cn: 那恐怕会吓坏不少人吧？

say:40:1321421028:1.text: That's right. Everyone at the time believed that the undead were minions of the Hypogeans. They thought that our ancestor betrayed Dura and joined the Hypogean side.
say:40:1321421028:1.source_cn: 没错。大家都以为活死人是恶魔的眷属，以为卡明斯基的先祖...

say:41:1321421029:1.text: Since then, the reputation of our family has been tarnished. Everyone spurned us, accusing us of having the blood of traitors...
say:41:1321421029:1.source_cn: 从那之后，卡明斯基的后裔就背上了恶名。所有人都唾弃我们...

say:42:1321421030:1.text: The scary thing is that some of our family members began to believe that our ancestor colluded with the Hypogeans. Many gave up the Kaminsky name and moved to the countryside, like our family... Others simply left the Duchy of Whiteridge.
say:42:1321421030:1.source_cn: 最可怕的是，家族中一些无从得知真相的人也渐渐相信先祖曾...

say:43:1321421031:1.text: The descendants that still live in the duchy should be only me and Peter. However, many people have long forgotten our relationship with the Kaminsky family.
say:43:1321421031:1.source_cn: 直到现在，依然留在白山公国境内的卡明斯基后裔，应该只有...

say:44:1321421032:1.text: You never told me this! Our parents never said anything either...
say:44:1321421032:1.source_cn: 这些事你从来都没告诉过我！爸妈也没和我讲过……

say:45:1321421033:1.text: Sorry, Peter. It was for your own good.
say:45:1321421033:1.source_cn: 抱歉，彼得……对你而言，很多事还是不知道的好。

say:46:1321421034:1.text: *Sigh*... After I joined the ducal guard, I always believed that I could rebuild our family's good name through my own achievements.
say:46:1321421034:1.source_cn: 而且我一直觉得……在我加入公国卫队以后，也许可以用自己...

choice_prompt:47:1321421034.text: *Sigh*... After I joined the ducal guard, I always believed that I could rebuild our family's good name through my own achievements.
choice_prompt:47:1321421034.source_cn: 而且我一直觉得……在我加入公国卫队以后，也许可以用自己的功劳为家族恢复名誉。

say:49:1321421039:1.text: However, after I was expelled from the guard and people started calling me a coward... I began to regret letting the undead warrior go.
say:49:1321421039:1.source_cn: 可是，在我被开除之后，在我听到别人骂我是懦夫的时候……...

say:50:1321421040:1.text: I came here to fight the undead to prove myself and show everyone that the Kaminsky family isn't as bad as they say.
say:50:1321421040:1.source_cn: 我来这里和活死人战斗，就是想证明自己，证明卡明斯基家族...

choice_prompt:51:1321421040.text: I came here to fight the undead to prove myself and show everyone that the Kaminsky family isn't as bad as they say.
choice_prompt:51:1321421040.source_cn: 我来这里和活死人战斗，就是想证明自己，证明卡明斯基家族绝没有大家说的那么不堪！

say:52:1321421041:1.text: Yes, our ancestor was a brave warrior. He was a true hero, like the female general.
say:52:1321421041:1.source_cn: 没错……我们的先祖不是懦夫，而是一位英勇的战士！是和女...

say:53:1321421042:1.text: Peter, we need to hold our heads high. We're descendants of the Kaminsky family, and our ancestor's legacy is something to be proud of.
say:53:1321421042:1.source_cn: 太好了，彼得……我们以后再也不用因为是卡明斯基的后裔而...

say:54:1321421043:1.text: You never mentioned this, and I never got the chance to feel proud.
say:54:1321421043:1.source_cn: ……哼，你都没告诉过我这件事，我都没机会抬不起头！

say:55:1321421044:1.text: If anyone badmouths our family in the future, I'm going to curse them back!
say:55:1321421044:1.source_cn: 不过以后要是还有人诋毁卡明斯基家族，我就有机会骂回去了——！

say:56:1321421045:1.text: Hahaha! Yes, we can finally clear our family name!
say:56:1321421045:1.source_cn: 哈哈，是啊，我们总算有机会为家族正名了。

say:57:1321421046:1.text: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, can you still find our <style="highlight">ancestor who became undead</style>? I want to <style="highlight">bury him</style> here so that he can finally rest in peace.
say:57:1321421046:1.male: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, can you still find our <style="highlight">ancestor who became undead</style>? I want to <style="highlight">bury him</style> here so that he can finally rest in peace.
say:57:1321421046:1.female: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, can you still find our <style="highlight">ancestor who became undead</style>? I want to <style="highlight">bury him</style> here so that he can finally rest in peace.

choice:51:0:1.source_cn: 你现在已经知道真相了

choice:47:0:1.source_cn: 你加入卫队是为了这个？

say:59:1321421036:1.text: I guess it has to do with my ancestor as well.
say:59:1321421036:1.source_cn: ……哈，或许是因为我其实也没有那么相信那位先祖吧。

say:60:1321421037:1.text: Every time I face the undead, I can't help but wonder if they turned to the Hypogeans because of some hardship in life or if they were forced into it against their will.
say:60:1321421037:1.source_cn: 每次遇到活死人，我总是在想，他们是不是有什么难处才选择...

say:61:1321421038:1.text: That's why, in the end, I let that undead warrior go. He helped the children, and at least he bore no ill will toward humans.
say:61:1321421038:1.source_cn: 所以我放走了那个好心指路的活死人。至少，他对人类没有恶意。

choice:47:1:2.text: Why did you let Igor go?
choice:47:1:2.source_cn: 那你为什么还要放走活死人？
choice:47:1:2.male: Why did you let Igor go?
choice:47:1:2.female: Why did you let Igor go?

say:0:1321422001:0.text: Should be right here. There's your ancestor.
say:0:1321422001:0.source_cn: 就是这里。眼前这位……就是你们的先祖。

narration:0:1321423001:0.text: With your help, Stephan and Peter bury their ancestor.
narration:0:1321423001:0.source_cn: 在你们的协助下，斯捷潘和小彼得两兄弟埋葬了他们的先祖

say:2:1321425001:1.text: Don't forget this talisman. Your ancestor left this for you.
say:2:1321425001:1.source_cn: 喏，别忘了带走这个护身符！这可是先祖留给你们的遗物！

say:3:1321425002:1.text: Thank you. I will forever keep it safe.
say:3:1321425002:1.source_cn: 谢谢，我一定会好好保存的。

say:4:1321425003:1.text: Once we're back in town, Peter and I will change our last name to Kaminsky again. We'll work hard to regain everyone's recognition and bring honor back to our family name.
say:4:1321425003:1.source_cn: 等回到镇上，我会和彼得改回卡明斯基这个姓氏，靠自己的努...

say:5:1321425004:1.text: I'll spread the word about the undead so more people can learn of the deeds of these unsung heroes and stop viewing them merely as Hypogean minions...
say:5:1321425004:1.source_cn: 当然，我也会把活死人的事告诉大家，让更多人知道这些无名...

say:9:1321425006:1.text: Yes, I promise. Starting today, I won't touch a drop ever again.
say:9:1321425006:1.source_cn: 没问题，从今天开始，一滴也不会再碰。

say:10:1321425007:1.text: As descendants of the Kaminsky family, we must avoid a life of indulgence and uphold our forebears' valor.
say:10:1321425007:1.source_cn: 卡明斯基的后裔，当然要继承先祖的英勇，绝不会颓废度日！
